🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
ts_eman 期指数移动平均（EWMA）
ts_pctd 期变化率：(x − x_shift(d)) / x_shift(d)

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 close：close
  2. 计算 mom：close / close.shift(21) - 1.0
  3. 计算 down_ret：np.where(returns < 0, returns, 空)
  4. 计算 down_ret_series：pd.Series(down_ret, index=df_copy.index)
  5. 计算 vol_short：down_ret_series.滚动窗口(21, min_periods=5).std(ddof=1)
  6. 计算 vol_long：down_ret_series.滚动窗口(63, min_periods=5).std(ddof=1)
  7. 计算 high_liquidity：style_gate_liquidity_high > 0
  8. 计算 vol：np.where(high_liquidity, vol_short, vol_long)
  9. 计算 vol：np.where(vol == 0.0, 空, vol)
  10. 计算 upside：(high - open).astype(float)
  11. 计算 downside：(open - low).astype(float)
  12. 计算 ema_up：pd.Series(talib.EMA(upside.values, timeperiod=20), index=df_copy.index)
  13. 计算 ema_down：pd.Series(talib.EMA(downside.values, timeperiod=20), index=df_copy.index)
  14. 计算 ratio：ema_down / ema_up
  15. 计算 asym_weight：1.0 / (1.0 + ratio)
  16. 计算 factor：mom / vol * asym_weight
⚠ 该因子原始 IC 为负，已整体取反（×(-1)）调正方向；下列步骤展示的是原始公式的计算过程。

🔍 公式逐行拆解（算子释义）

  1. shift(21) — shift(n) → 滞后/移位
  2. std(negative_returns,21) — std(x, n) → 滚动标准差
  3. std(negative_returns,63) — std(x, n) → 滚动标准差
  4. EMA(downside_open_low) — talib.EMA(x, n) → 指数均线
  5. EMA(upside_high_open) — talib.EMA(x, n) → 指数均线

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_liquidity_adaptive_asym_momentum(df): df_copy = df.copy() close = df_copy["str">'close'] returns = close.pct_change() mom = close / close.shift(21) - 1.0 down_ret = np.where(returns < 0, returns, np.nan) down_ret_series = pd.Series(down_ret, index=df_copy.index) vol_short = down_ret_series.rolling(21, min_periods=5).std(ddof=1) vol_long = down_ret_series.rolling(63, min_periods=5).std(ddof=1) high_liquidity = df_copy["str">'style_gate_liquidity_high'] > 0 vol = np.where(high_liquidity, vol_short, vol_long) vol = np.where(vol == 0.0, np.nan, vol) upside = (df_copy["str">'high'] - df_copy["str">'open']).astype(float) downside = (df_copy["str">'open'] - df_copy["str">'low']).astype(float) ema_up = pd.Series(talib.EMA(upside.values, timeperiod=20), index=df_copy.index) ema_down = pd.Series(talib.EMA(downside.values, timeperiod=20), index=df_copy.index) ratio = ema_down / ema_up.replace(0, np.nan) asym_weight = 1.0 / (1.0 + ratio.fillna(np.nan)) factor = mom / vol * asym_weight df_copy["str">'factor_liquidity_adaptive_asym_momentum'] = factor.fillna(np.nan) "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["str">'factor_liquidity_adaptive_asym_momentum']
